title: FTFN Canonical Living Encyclopedia
summary: Twenty-seven authored chapters that explain the current FTFN evidence corpus as a conversion system: seventeen domain chapters and ten cross-system foundations, all resolved exclusively through existing Published records.
publication_boundary: This edition interprets existing Published repository records. It creates no new source fact, advances no scheduled evidence gate, admits no observation, and makes no causal finding, forecast, recommendation, score, ranking or outcome claim. Historical baseline means the dated baseline represented by the cited repository shelf, not a complete history of the field.

topic_chapters.title: Advanced manufacturing: capacity has to be accepted before it can be counted
topic_chapters.deck: Factories, training systems and delivery programs become strategic capacity only through qualified people, controlled processes, accepted output and repeatable performance.
executive_synthesis: The Published shelf shows advanced manufacturing as a coupled production system rather than a collection of factory announcements. Drive48 reports an operating training facility and more than 2,000 graduates; Monaghan Medical's certified project record pairs completed investment with a current employment count; the F-15EX record fixes delivery to a named receiving wing; and the KC-46 plan separates three availability workstreams. Together they show that facilities, workforce, delivered assets and operational readiness are related but non-interchangeable forms of evidence.

The central editorial conclusion is therefore procedural: capacity should be traced through facility readiness, workforce preparation, process qualification, accepted output and performance in the receiving system. A completed building or funded expansion can remove a constraint without proving stable yield, dependable throughput or mission availability.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline begins with annual manufacturing statistics and named program commitments, then advances to operating training capacity, certified project completion, realized aircraft receipt and readiness planning. This is a bounded history of what the current shelf can document; it is not a complete history of manufacturing technology or industrial policy.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Current records are strongest at the infrastructure and acceptance boundary. They identify operating training, completed projects, present employment, named delivery receipts and explicit readiness plans. They remain thinner on comparable line-level yield, supplier continuity, rework, maintenance burden and recurring accepted output across stable periods.

conversion_chain.reading: Fix the named project, promised capability, site, equipment and completion record.
Show trained people, certified procedures, tooling, quality controls and material availability.
Record the receiving party, acceptance basis, quantity, date and any remediation still open.
Measure stable yield, delivery cadence, availability and quality over a declared period.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A completed or expanded plant is equivalent to new strategic production capacity.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The shelf separates project certification and employment from line qualification, recurring output and receiver acceptance.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Delivery of a named aircraft establishes readiness across the receiving fleet.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The named F-15EX receipt is a delivery event, while the KC-46 record explicitly identifies separate work needed to improve availability.

decisive_evidence: A stable facility-and-line denominator with accepted units, yield, rework and downtime for repeated periods.
Receiving-system acceptance records that identify configuration, date and unresolved deficiencies.
Workforce evidence that links graduates or hires to qualified roles and retained operating capacity.
claim_boundaries: Training completions do not prove regional workforce sufficiency.
Certified project completion does not prove recurring qualified production.
Delivery does not prove readiness, availability or public outcome.

topic_chapters.title: Agriculture and bioeconomy: funded traits are not field outcomes
topic_chapters.deck: Research awards, market outlooks and plant-trait rules establish important upstream conditions while leaving seed availability, producer adoption and realized performance downstream.
executive_synthesis: The agriculture shelf contains four distinct forms of evidence: crop-market outlook revisions, plant-trait assessment rules, a named set of breeding awards and funded production-and-resilience research. Those records clarify expectations, authorization conditions and research direction. None by itself establishes that a trait is commercially available, adopted by producers or improving yields and resilience under field conditions.

A useful public account must follow a trait or practice through research, assessment, multiplication, distribution, adoption and seasonally comparable results. The geographic and climatic context matters because performance cannot be transferred from a funded research objective to a farm, crop or region without a matching field record.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The current dated baseline moves from federal breeding support and production-resilience research to 2026 Canadian assessment rules and a July 2026 U.S. crop outlook revision. It records the shelf's policy, research and market sequence rather than a comprehensive history of agricultural innovation.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The evidence is bounded and upstream: named awards, defined regulatory treatment and revised commodity expectations. There is no admitted chain in this chapter from a named funded trait to commercial seed, a defined producer cohort, measured water or input use, and repeated regional yield or resilience outcomes.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify the funded trait, crop, institution, method and intended production or resilience problem.
Document the applicable rule, authorization disposition and any use conditions.
Fix seed or input availability, eligible geography and a stable producer or acreage denominator.
Compare yield, input, water and resilience measures across declared seasons and conditions.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Research funding is evidence that climate-resilient or higher-output agriculture has arrived.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The award records state research purposes; they do not report commercial availability, adoption or measured farm outcomes.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A regulatory directive either proves safety or blocks innovation in general.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The CFIA record defines an assessment pathway for specified plant-trait cases and does not support either universal conclusion.

decisive_evidence: Named release or assessment decisions tied to the same trait and intended use as the research award.
Commercial availability and adoption records with acreage, producer and geography denominators.
Repeated field results with methods, comparator, season and local water or climate conditions.
claim_boundaries: A grant establishes funded work, not a delivered agricultural capability.
A crop outlook is a dated forecast and revision record, not a realized harvest outcome.
Authorization does not establish adoption, yield or regional resilience.

topic_chapters.title: AI for science: evaluation and access precede reproduced discovery
topic_chapters.deck: National research infrastructure and assurance methods can widen access and make systems testable, but scientific value still depends on reproducible work and institutional use.
executive_synthesis: The current shelf connects federal research priorities, a national AI research-resource pilot, a completed NIST ARIA evaluation pilot and a metrology method-selection layer. This establishes public direction, access infrastructure and concrete evaluation practice. It does not establish that AI-generated findings have been independently reproduced, incorporated into scientific workflows or translated into durable research outcomes.

The chapter therefore treats compute access, data access, evaluation design and scientific validation as separate dependencies. A larger inventory of AI uses or a completed pilot can describe activity and evaluation capability; neither substitutes for task-level performance, external replication, monitoring in use or evidence that research decisions improved.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The shelf's baseline starts with federal R&D priorities and the NAIRR pilot, then adds NIST's completed multi-level ARIA pilot and an explicit metrology-selection layer. It shows an institutional move from general direction toward testable infrastructure and evaluation, without asserting a general history of AI-enabled science.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence supports the existence of research-access and assurance mechanisms. It is less complete at the transition from evaluation to authorized institutional workflow, reproduced result, production monitoring and observed scientific or operational benefit.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify compute, data, tools, eligible users and the duration of access.
Declare the scientific task, comparator, method, failure mode and performance boundary.
Record reproduction by an independent group and resolution of contradictory results.
Show authorization, workflow integration, monitoring, incidents and measurable decision effects.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Rapid growth in public AI inventories demonstrates operational scientific transformation.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Inventory records describe reported uses and development stages; the shelf separately requires operational status and outcome evidence.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A successful evaluation pilot validates AI systems generally.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: ARIA is a bounded multi-level pilot, while NIST's metrology layer emphasizes method selection for specific questions and contexts.

decisive_evidence: Task-specific evaluations with declared comparators, error analysis and accessible methods.
Independent reproduction records tied to the same model, data and scientific claim.
Authorized workflow use with monitoring, incidents and a bounded measure of changed research performance.
claim_boundaries: Access to compute and data is infrastructure, not a scientific result.
A completed pilot does not authorize production use or prove broad reliability.
Inventory growth does not establish adoption quality or scientific outcome.

topic_chapters.title: Aviation: rules and trials are not recurring service
topic_chapters.deck: Aviation innovation crosses an unusually explicit chain of rulemaking, aircraft certification, operator approval, site readiness, tested performance and continuing safe service.
executive_synthesis: The aviation shelf separates a final powered-lift operating rule, eight federal integration-pilot selections, DARPA's measured Lift Challenge result and annual carrier-service reporting. These records span permission, planned integration, experimental performance and established service measurement. Their value comes from not collapsing them into a single claim that advanced aircraft service has arrived.

The measured Lift Challenge result closes one competition gate, including named ratios and awards, while leaving maturation, manufacture, certification and deployment open. Likewise, the powered-lift rule supplies an operating framework but not a certified aircraft, approved operator, usable vertiport network or repeated passenger service.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: Within the current repository, the baseline runs from mature annual air-carrier reporting to a new powered-lift operating rule, selected integration pilots and the August 2026 Lift Challenge result. This juxtaposition makes the missing denominators for emerging service visible without treating incumbent and experimental aviation as directly comparable.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The strongest new evidence concerns rules, selections and a bounded field-trial result. Carrier cancellation reporting provides an example of what recurring service evidence looks like: a defined reporting population and period. Equivalent denominators are not yet present for powered-lift passenger service.

conversion_chain.reading: Separate operating rules from aircraft type, production and airworthiness approvals.
Identify the approved operator, routes, sites, airspace and local emergency arrangements.
Publish measured test conditions, failures, acceptance basis and unresolved restrictions.
Count completed service, exposure, cancellations, incidents and reliability on a stable denominator.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A final powered-lift rule means commercial eVTOL service is operationally ready.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The rule closes one regulatory layer while certification, operators, aircraft, sites and recurring flights remain separate.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A competition-leading prototype result predicts deployed performance.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: DARPA reports a bounded scored event and explicitly leaves follow-on maturation and transition downstream.

decisive_evidence: Aircraft and operator approvals linked to named routes and service geographies.
Accepted site, airspace, maintenance and emergency-response records.
Repeated service and safety exposure with comparable flight, passenger and event denominators.
claim_boundaries: A rule does not certify an aircraft or operator.
A selected pilot does not establish completed flights or public service.
A field-trial prize does not establish production, certification or deployment.

topic_chapters.title: Chips and compute: facilities convert through power, water, people and accepted output
topic_chapters.deck: Semiconductor and data-center announcements become operating capacity only when local infrastructure, permits, workforce, construction and customer acceptance align.
executive_synthesis: The shelf anchors compute expansion in two receiving systems. In Phoenix, a planning envelope, fab construction milestone, apprenticeship pipeline and wastewater agreement expose the dependencies around a named semiconductor campus. In Northern Virginia, load concentration, a new very-large-load rate class and generator-permit controls show how compute demand meets utility planning, cost allocation and local environmental authority.

These records demonstrate why headline investment is an incomplete denominator. A topped-out facility is not commissioned output; a service-territory statement is not customer capacity; a tariff is not energized load; and a wastewater agreement is not measured reuse. The chapter follows each dependency to the record that would prove actual conversion.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline starts with planning and service-territory records, then adds construction, workforce, utility, water and permitting artifacts around named corridors. It is a history of documented project conversion in those places, not a global history or market estimate for semiconductors and compute.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence is dense around authority and infrastructure commitments. It supports named planning envelopes, construction stages, workforce mechanisms, rate treatment and permit conditions. It does not yet provide a complete common record for energized demand, fab acceptance, qualified production yield, measured customer output or project-specific water reuse.

conversion_chain.reading: Fix the parcel, planning envelope, permits, conditions and legal authority.
Name power, transmission, water, wastewater and qualified-labor dependencies with dates and capacity bounds.
Distinguish construction milestones from commissioning, energization and accepted process tools.
Report product, yield, customer qualification, volume and operating period without transferring corporate projections.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Announced investment or a topping-out milestone proves new chip capacity.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The Phoenix records preserve downstream commissioning, utility service, process qualification and accepted customer output.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Forecast data-center demand is equivalent to load that utilities must already serve.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: PJM and Virginia records distinguish firm and non-firm demand, future rate treatment and realized service.

decisive_evidence: Named energization and utility-capacity records tied to a facility and service date.
Commissioning and customer-qualification records for the same fab, process and product family.
Measured power, water, wastewater and output on compatible project operating periods.
claim_boundaries: Planning approval and construction progress do not establish operating capacity.
A workforce program does not prove role placement or sufficient qualified staffing.
Regional load and water evidence cannot be attributed to a customer without a named record.

topic_chapters.title: Climate: observation becomes resilience through local decisions
topic_chapters.deck: Global and national climate evidence is indispensable context, but adaptation and resilience claims require named assets, exposed populations, decisions and observed losses or service continuity.
executive_synthesis: The climate shelf connects a dated NOAA ENSO discussion, the Fifth National Climate Assessment's transportation-risk synthesis and an EPA infrastructure-funding review denominator. A Kennedy Space Center record adds one completed prescribed-burn event coordinated during an active launch countdown. Together these establish observed or assessed conditions, lifecycle risk, administrative state and a bounded local operating adaptation; they do not automatically establish reduced loss or durable resilience.

The necessary translation is geographic and institutional. A climate condition becomes decision evidence only after it is connected to a named place, asset or population; an accountable authority; an exposure and vulnerability baseline; an adopted response; delivered work; and an outcome measured over a defined event or period. The Kennedy event demonstrates feasibility in one context, not a repeated program or quantified resilience benefit.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The current shelf's dated baseline includes a recurring climate-risk clock, a national assessment that frames transportation resilience across the asset lifecycle, a later review of infrastructure award states and one 2026 Space Coast operating adaptation. It deliberately avoids presenting this shelf as a complete climate history or emissions inventory.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence supports high-level observation, assessment, administrative status and one place-specific operating event. It remains thin at the fully joined record: asset-level hazard, vulnerable users, accepted and repeated adaptation, maintenance, event performance and avoided-loss analysis with a defensible counterfactual.

conversion_chain.reading: Separate observed climate condition, forecast, scenario and local hazard footprint.
Identify affected assets and populations, responsible authority and decision threshold.
Track funding, design, construction, acceptance, maintenance and service continuity.
Compare losses, outages or recovery under declared events, exposure and baseline assumptions.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A global indicator or seasonal outlook directly specifies a local project decision.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The evidence stack requires local hazard, exposure and authority records before a decision claim is made.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Obligated or reviewed infrastructure funding establishes adaptation benefit.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The EPA denominator retains distinct approval, cancellation and litigation states and does not report delivered resilience outcomes.

decisive_evidence: Named local hazard and vulnerability records linked to exposed assets and populations.
Accepted adaptation works with maintenance and service-continuity evidence.
Event or longitudinal outcomes with exposure-adjusted losses, outages or recovery measures.
claim_boundaries: A forecast is not an observed local impact.
A national assessment is not an asset-specific vulnerability finding.
Funding status does not prove delivery, resilience or avoided loss.

topic_chapters.title: Critical minerals: resources become supply only through qualified material
topic_chapters.deck: Mineral inventories, land decisions, permits and finance remove different constraints; industrial supply begins with accepted, specification-conforming output.
executive_synthesis: The critical-minerals shelf spans national production and import-reliance data, federal project selections, named Nevada land and water decisions, a financial close, air-permit compliance and reclamation assurance. It therefore makes a long conversion chain visible: strategic concern, resource and project identity, authority, finance, construction, processing, qualification and customer use.

No upstream artifact can stand in for the last stages. A mineral occurrence is not a reserve; a federal land decision is not construction; a loan closing is not production; and production is not necessarily qualified material accepted into a named industrial process. Environmental compliance and closure liabilities remain part of the operating case rather than external footnotes.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline combines annual mineral-production and import-exposure records with named project decisions and financing artifacts. Later permit and assurance records add conditions that remain active through operation and closure. This is a conversion history for the covered records, not a global reserve or supply forecast.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus is comparatively strong on resource context, authorization and project conditions. It has named federal selections, land decisions, state permits and finance. The open edge is the complete chain from constructed plant through commissioned process, specification-conforming batches, recurring output and identified customer acceptance.

conversion_chain.reading: Fix commodity, deposit, grade or import denominator without converting it into recoverable supply.
Track land, water, air, reclamation and credit decisions as distinct conditions.
Record built assets, commissioned equipment, recovery process and operating constraints.
Show specification, batch, volume, period and customer acceptance for recurring material.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A large domestic resource or project approval resolves import dependence.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: USGS exposure data and named project records leave construction, processing, qualification, volume and substitution downstream.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Environmental permits are secondary to supply capacity.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Air monitoring, water conditions, reclamation assurance and compliance reporting are explicit operating dependencies in the named files.

decisive_evidence: Commissioning and operating records for the named mine and processing facilities.
Repeated specification-conforming batch and volume records with a stable period.
Named customer qualification, compliance performance and closure-liability updates.
claim_boundaries: Production-value and import data do not establish project-level supply.
Land, water and air decisions do not establish construction or operation.
Financial close does not establish qualified material or reduced import reliance.

topic_chapters.title: Cybersecurity: obligations become risk reduction through verified implementation
topic_chapters.deck: Directives, vulnerability lists and standards define work; inventories, remediation, effective controls and incident evidence show whether systems actually changed.
executive_synthesis: The cybersecurity shelf joins recurring federal asset-visibility obligations, monitoring-data quality limits, hospital control tests, open NASA recommendations and post-quantum interoperability work. This makes cybersecurity observable as an institutional operating discipline rather than a collection of policy declarations or technical specifications.

The evidence also resists a common shortcut: compliance activity is not automatically reduced risk. An agency can inventory assets incompletely, close some recommendations while others remain open, or test one institution effectively without establishing sector-wide performance. The unit of claim must stay attached to the assessed system, period, control set and reviewer.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline begins with binding asset-visibility and vulnerability-management obligations, then follows annual assessments, data-quality findings and named remediation portfolios. Post-quantum records add a forward migration problem whose success requires inventory, interoperability, cutover and retirement evidence.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Current evidence is strongest for obligations, assessments and explicit open work. It contains recurring institutional findings and bounded control tests. It is weaker on completed remediation linked to verified control effectiveness, exposure-adjusted incidents and durable risk reduction across comparable reporting periods.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify covered assets, deadline, control owner and completeness test.
Record deployed controls, exceptions, remediation owner and evidence of configuration.
Use scoped tests, audit findings and closure evidence rather than self-attestation alone.
Measure incidents, exposure, recovery and recurrence with stable system and time denominators.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Issuing a directive or publishing a standard materially secures covered systems.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Asset-data correction needs, open recommendations and institution-specific control tests show that implementation remains separate.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Closure of one recommendation proves broad institutional cyber resilience.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: A closure applies to a named action and sufficiency judgment; it does not establish all controls, all assets or incident reduction.

decisive_evidence: Complete asset and dependency inventories tested against an independent denominator.
Closure records paired with configuration or operating tests for the same control population.
Comparable incident, exposure and recovery series with changes in scope disclosed.
claim_boundaries: A directive establishes an obligation, not compliance.
One effective institutional test does not generalize to a sector.
A migration draft or procurement path does not establish completed cryptographic cutover.

topic_chapters.title: Discovery technologies: public data is infrastructure, not impact
topic_chapters.deck: Scientific data systems and observation platforms widen what can be studied; validated models, institutional uptake and changed decisions require their own records.
executive_synthesis: The Published shelf joins four concrete discovery infrastructures. NSF's integrated data-systems awards fund the layer between datasets and AI-enabled research; NISAR's public radar products move a named Earth-observation mission from promise to accessible data; NIST METIS exposes initial semiconductor-metrology datasets; and a funded AI-Materials Institute defines an institutional attempt to connect models, multimodal data and experiments. These records establish awards, access surfaces and a bounded beta—not validated discovery impact.

The records do not complete the impact chain. Data availability says nothing by itself about calibration quality for a particular use, independent validation of derived models, delivery of the proposed materials portal, adoption by a public or scientific institution, or a changed decision. The chapter makes those downstream questions explicit and keeps each observation, metrology and materials system separate.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The current baseline contains four bounded transitions: funded scientific data infrastructure, a funded AI-to-materials institute, initial data in a metrology exchange beta and July 2026 access to public NISAR radar products. This selected Published shelf is not a proxy for the history or total state of discovery technology.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The shelf establishes investment in data systems, a delivered observation product and an initial shared-data surface. It does not yet establish a common documented sequence through user access, method validation, portal delivery, reproduced finding, institutional adoption and measurable decision or scientific effect.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify mission or program, product, coverage, method and operating status.
Show discoverability, usable formats, calibration, limitations and fitness for a named task.
Record analysis method, independent reproduction and contradictory results.
Identify the institution, decision, prior baseline and observable change linked to use.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Making a major observation dataset public democratizes discovery by itself.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The shelf establishes access, while compute, expertise, validation, usable tooling and institutional adoption remain unmeasured.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Funding integrated data systems demonstrates successful AI-enabled science.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The award identifies intended infrastructure; no reproduced scientific result or adoption outcome is reported in that record.

decisive_evidence: Stable usage and access measures separated from mere download availability.
Independently reproduced analyses tied to the same product version and method.
Named institutional decisions or scientific workflows with documented before-and-after evidence.
claim_boundaries: A grant is evidence of funded infrastructure, not completed capability.
Public data availability is not validation of every downstream use.
A derived finding does not establish institutional adoption or impact.

topic_chapters.title: Energy: nameplate capacity is the beginning of the operating question
topic_chapters.deck: Power systems are understood through named assets, connection and acceptance, actual dispatch, constraint events, safety, reliability and service over time.
executive_synthesis: The energy shelf contains unusually rich asset-level battery records. Manatee has a stable nameplate panel and a named monthly operating record; Hornsdale combines capacity, service-setting limits, enforcement and later event response; Dalrymple exposes multi-service operation and state-of-charge constraints; Gateway and Moss Landing show how thermal events, audits and corrective actions complicate capacity-only readings.

This evidence demonstrates that megawatts are an identity and capability measure, not an outcome. Useful claims require duration, availability, dispatch context, state of charge, service definition, constraint and safety records. Even a documented response event remains one observation unless it joins a stable repeated series.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline follows named storage assets across annual capacity panels, later official project and market records, individual response or constraint events, incident review and corrective-action status. It is not a complete grid history or a cross-market ranking; each asset retains its own identity and reporting context.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The shelf can distinguish stable nameplate, confirmed later operation, individual event response, visible constraints and safety remediation. It does not yet support a common longitudinal comparison of availability, dispatched energy, reliability contribution, avoided cost or public value across all covered assets.

conversion_chain.reading: Fix asset, site, power, duration, ownership and commissioning status.
Record network connection, testing, acceptance and service eligibility.
Observe state of charge, response, dispatch, outage, constraint and incident context.
Use stable periods and service definitions for reliability, cost and resilience analysis.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Installed megawatts are a sufficient measure of grid value.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The covered records show duration, state of charge, dispatch use, constraints and incidents changing what the same nameplate can provide.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A successful response event proves durable reliability contribution.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Hornsdale and Dalrymple event records are bounded observations and require repeated compatible periods for a longitudinal claim.

decisive_evidence: Recurring asset-level availability, dispatch and outage data using a stable operating denominator.
Service-specific performance linked to event conditions and market or network requirements.
Safety, remediation and return-to-service records kept with the same facility identity.
claim_boundaries: Nameplate power does not establish duration, availability or delivered energy.
A later operating record does not by itself establish longitudinal system value.
Different assets and market periods are not comparable until definitions align.

topic_chapters.title: Finance and risk: capital enables conversion but does not complete it
topic_chapters.deck: Loans, tariffs, budgets and project pipelines allocate risk and possibility; procurement, construction, acceptance and operating cash flows determine delivery.
executive_synthesis: The finance shelf connects construction intentions, a Toronto housing pipeline, a preliminary capital-project pipeline, a federal loan closing and a special utility rate class for very large loads. Each record changes the conditions under which projects may proceed, yet none can be read as a completed asset or outcome.

Finance is therefore both an enabling layer and a risk-allocation system. A closed loan identifies capital and obligations; a tariff identifies who may bear service costs and risks; an approved or proposed pipeline identifies intended activity. The next records are executed procurement, actual expenditure, construction progress, acceptance, service and liabilities that remain after delivery.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The current baseline moves from permits and development applications through stage-specific housing data, project pipeline publication, financial close and new rate treatment. It documents several points where financial and administrative records precede physical conversion, not a comprehensive financial-market history.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence is strong enough to separate intention, authority, financing and cost-allocation decisions. It remains insufficient to attribute completed output or public benefit to those instruments without linked contract, expenditure, asset and operating records.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify project, sponsor, amount, conditions, risk assumptions and contingent liabilities.
Distinguish announced pipeline, budget authority, executed finance and awarded contract.
Track expenditure, schedule, change orders, completion and acceptance.
Measure service, revenue, affordability, liability and outcome on a declared period.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Financial close or budget inclusion establishes that a project will be delivered.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The named records preserve procurement, construction, acceptance and production as later gates.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A project pipeline is a reliable measure of forthcoming supply.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Toronto and Statistics Canada records explicitly separate approvals and intentions from starts, active construction and completions.

decisive_evidence: Executed contracts and expenditure tied to the same project and financial commitment.
Construction, completion and acceptance records with scope and schedule changes disclosed.
Operating revenue, service, affordability and liability evidence on a stable period.
claim_boundaries: A permit or financing instrument is not a completed asset.
A pipeline is not procurement, construction or delivered supply.
Modeled benefits or projected returns are not realized public value.

topic_chapters.title: Human futures: receiving systems decide whether capability becomes benefit
topic_chapters.deck: Housing, labor, institutions and public services are not downstream scenery; they are the systems through which technical change is admitted, distributed and experienced.
executive_synthesis: The Human Futures shelf grounds abstract social impact in named administrative and place records. Toronto's 24 254930 application clears a council gate while enactment conditions remain. Phoenix and Maricopa workforce baselines describe wages and covered employment without proving fab readiness. HHS and VA recommendation files show how public institutions can carry named implementation work over time.

These records support a receiving-system interpretation: technical capacity becomes socially meaningful through housing, labor access, services, affordability, institutional capability and legitimate authority. A regional growth projection or project announcement cannot reveal who can participate, who bears cost, whether services remain available or whether a public institution can deliver its assigned work.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The bounded baseline includes regional projections, local workforce and wage measures, a named housing-authority sequence and public-agency implementation findings. It is not a general social history. It shows the kinds of receiving-system records that must be joined to a technical project before distributional claims are made.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus identifies local authority, workforce conditions and institutional implementation gaps. It is less complete on joined household-level affordability, access, displacement, service quality and distribution across communities over time. Those missing joins are treated as gaps, not filled by regional averages.

conversion_chain.reading: Define affected people, geography, services, labor market and housing conditions.
Identify who decides, who has standing, conditions, appeals and unresolved public process.
Measure who can use the capability, who bears burdens and which supports are available.
Track affordability, security, health, service quality and remedy for a stable cohort and period.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Regional job or investment growth demonstrates broad household benefit.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The workforce records provide aggregate baselines and expressly do not establish role readiness, access, distribution or affordability.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A council decision completes local legitimacy and delivery.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The Toronto file preserves enactment conditions, servicing, permits, construction and occupancy as distinct gates.

decisive_evidence: Joined project and place measures for jobs, qualification, housing cost, service access and displacement.
Dated implementation and remedy records from responsible public institutions.
Distributional outcomes for identified communities, with aggregate and subgroup denominators kept visible.
claim_boundaries: Regional employment and wage baselines do not prove project attribution or equitable access.
Authority does not establish delivery or consent from every affected public.
Institutional plans and recommendations do not establish implemented service outcomes.

topic_chapters.title: Mobility: permission, passenger use and reliable access are different achievements
topic_chapters.deck: Transport systems convert through authority, accepted assets, accessible service, exposure-based safety and repeated reliability—not through vehicle capability alone.
executive_synthesis: The mobility shelf reaches two unusually concrete forms of service evidence. California has effective authority for expanded fared Waymo driverless service and a later named recall that bounds a weather-handling constraint. Amtrak records station projects turned over for passenger use, final completions, accessibility backlogs and incompatible passenger-information deployment inventories.

Together these cases show why a mobility claim must keep operator, geography, asset and user state attached. Regulatory authority is not a trip count; passenger use is not necessarily final closeout; an inventory total can change because its cohort or method changed; and a recall is a bounded safety intervention rather than a general verdict on all automated service.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline follows autonomous mobility from public-road testing and service authority into an operating recall, while the intercity-rail shelf follows designs and projects into passenger use, final completion, accessibility and revised deployment counts. It is a conversion history for selected systems, not a comprehensive modal comparison.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Current records are strongest for named authority, project-stage inventories and particular operating constraints. They remain incomplete for recurring service quality by named asset, compatible passenger exposure, accessibility in actual journeys and safety comparison across stable operating domains.

conversion_chain.reading: Fix operator, geography, service type, conditions and effective date.
Separate construction, substantial completion, passenger use, final closeout and accessible use.
Count trips, passengers, asset availability, cancellations, defects and incidents.
Measure repeat performance and user access on stable asset, journey and exposure denominators.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Driverless service authority establishes superior or broadly safe autonomous mobility.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The authority is bounded by operator and geography, while the named recall shows an operating constraint that requires its own exposure context.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A completed station project or PIDS inventory establishes accessible, reliable passenger service.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Amtrak records separate passenger use, final completion, digital defects, asset backlogs and incompatible deployment counts.

decisive_evidence: Named-asset service, reliability and accessibility records tied to actual passenger use.
Autonomous-service exposure, intervention, incident and recall data within a stable operating domain.
Reconciled inventories whose cohort, completion definition and revision history remain stable.
claim_boundaries: Permission does not prove service volume, reliability or comparative safety.
Passenger-use turnover is not identical to final completion or program closeout.
Inventory counts cannot be trended across a documented cohort or method break without reconciliation.

topic_chapters.title: Policy and standards: adopted text begins the implementation trail
topic_chapters.deck: Rules, standards and recommendations matter because they define obligations and interfaces; implementation requires inventories, procurement, conformance, closure and monitored use.
executive_synthesis: The shelf spans FAA operator transition, GSA post-quantum procurement paths and agency recommendation portfolios in which some actions are closed while others remain open. These records show policy as an executable sequence: a responsible authority adopts a requirement, covered entities identify scope, implementation work is assigned, evidence is tested and a reviewer records disposition.

A publication date is therefore not an adoption outcome. Standards can remain drafts, final texts can await implementation profiles, and a closed recommendation can address one named action while adjacent weaknesses persist. The chapter treats revision, exceptions, conformance and retirement of legacy practice as first-class records.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The current baseline moves from adopted rules and standards into procurement mappings, operator transition and recommendation follow-up. It illustrates how text becomes administrative work, without claiming that the selected U.S. records represent all jurisdictions or the whole history of standardization.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus is strong on issued requirements, named implementation actions and granular open-or-closed dispositions. It is less complete on cross-entity conformance, production use, monitored exceptions and demonstrated performance after adoption.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify issuer, legal status, version, effective date, scope and required outcome.
Name covered systems, owners, inventory, procurement path, deadline and exception process.
Require evidence against explicit criteria and preserve open, partial and closed states.
Monitor use, failures, incidents, costs and revision needs after implementation.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A final standard or rule produces immediate compliance.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The GSA and agency follow-up records expose procurement, inventory, authorities and closure work after publication.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A closed recommendation proves the wider program is effective.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The records keep each recommendation identity separate and often show closed and open actions in the same portfolio.

decisive_evidence: Covered-system inventories and owner-approved implementation plans tied to the exact standard version.
Independent conformance or closure evidence with exception and residual-risk records.
Post-adoption operating evidence, including incidents, performance and legacy-system retirement.
claim_boundaries: Publication or finalization does not establish implementation.
A procurement path does not prove acquisition, deployment or conformance.
Recommendation closure is bounded to the named criterion and reviewed evidence.

topic_chapters.title: Quantum: readiness is a migration problem before it is a deployment claim
topic_chapters.deck: The current public evidence is strongest where quantum risk becomes concrete standards, credential changes, inventories, procurement and dated system transitions.
executive_synthesis: The quantum shelf is deliberately centered on post-quantum cryptography. It separates final 2024 standards, NIST's 2025 selection of HQC as a backup algorithm, preliminary PIV credential specifications and federal migration plans with dated transitions. This gives the topic an implementation spine rather than relying on generalized quantum-computing expectations.

The resulting question is not whether an algorithm has been selected, but whether organizations know which systems and dependencies are exposed, acquire interoperable implementations, validate them, complete cutover and retire vulnerable legacy components. A backup-algorithm selection is not yet a standard, and a working draft is not a deployed credential system.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: Within the repository, the baseline runs from NIST's final PQC standards to a later backup-algorithm selection, working credential drafts and federal migration obligations. It documents the beginning of a long transition and does not claim completed migration or characterize the full state of quantum computing.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence establishes standards, selections, draft implementation guidance and planning requirements. It does not yet establish complete cryptographic inventories, interoperable production implementations, accepted cutovers or retired legacy cryptography across a named institution.

conversion_chain.reading: Preserve algorithm, version, status, intended role and unresolved specification work.
Identify systems, data lifetimes, protocols, credentials, suppliers and owners.
Test implementations, interoperability, performance, fallback and migration safety.
Record accepted production use, exceptions, incidents and verified legacy removal.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Final PQC standards mean quantum-related cyber risk is addressed.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Migration plans, credential drafts and interoperability work show that standards begin rather than complete institutional transition.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Selection of a backup algorithm is equivalent to a deployable standard.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The HQC record explicitly preserves the gap between selection, standardization and implementation.

decisive_evidence: Complete institution-level cryptographic inventories with system and owner denominators.
Interoperability and conformance results for production candidate implementations.
Accepted cutover, monitored operation and verified retirement records for named systems.
claim_boundaries: A final standard is not organization-level implementation.
An algorithm selection is not a completed standard or procurement.
A migration plan or draft does not prove cutover, validation or legacy retirement.

topic_chapters.title: Space: infrastructure and licences become capability through missions and cadence
topic_chapters.deck: Architecture, launch-site authority and completed infrastructure are necessary; usable space capacity appears through licensed missions, accepted operations and repeat performance.
executive_synthesis: The space shelf connects NASA's Moon to Mars architecture, two final environmental decisions, a multi-user Kennedy master plan, an operational causeway bridge, a current Launch Complex 46 site licence and a rising annual count of FAA-licensed operations. The evidence therefore spans system design, place planning, authority, infrastructure and aggregate activity.

Those stages must remain separate. A system architecture is not integrated mission hardware; an environmental decision is not a construction or launch authorization; a site licence is not an operator or mission licence; and an aggregate operation count does not identify utilization, reliability or economic benefit at a particular facility.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository baseline moves from architecture and master planning through federal environmental decisions, completed local infrastructure, continuing site authority and an annual licensed-operation rail. It is a selected institutional and Space Coast conversion history rather than a comprehensive account of world space activity.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus supports named plans, site and environmental authority, one operational enabling asset and increasing licensed activity. It remains incomplete at the join among site, operator, mission, payload, range availability, turnaround, reliability and recurring utilization.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify capability, interfaces, mission sequence and dependencies without treating architecture as delivered hardware.
Separate land, site licence, environmental decision, construction and mission-specific approval.
Record accepted hardware, operator, range, payload, launch licence and completed event.
Measure repeat operations, turnaround, reliability and use by named site and operator.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A final environmental decision or active site licence means launch capability is operational.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The records preserve construction, operator, mission licensing, safety and completed operations as separate.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A national rise in licensed operations proves increased utilization at every spaceport.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The aggregate FAA series cannot be transferred to a named site without site- and operator-level denominators.

decisive_evidence: Mission-specific licences and completed operations tied to the same operator and site.
Accepted infrastructure and range-availability records with maintenance and safety constraints.
Recurring mission, turnaround and utilization series using stable site and operation definitions.
claim_boundaries: Architecture is not integrated, accepted mission capability.
Environmental and site decisions are not mission authorization or completion.
Aggregate national operations do not establish named-site cadence or outcomes.

topic_chapters.title: Water: plans become security through measured, maintained service
topic_chapters.deck: Water availability is local and operational: rights, conservation rules, treatment assets, service agreements, measured volumes and quality must align.
executive_synthesis: The water shelf distinguishes an operating reclaimed-water system in Chandler, Phoenix groundwater-management requirements, a preliminary wastewater capital program, a project-specific TSMC agreement and Toronto Water's long-horizon capital constraints. It pairs system operation with governance and future capacity rather than converting all water references into a single availability claim.

Chandler's reported operating scale is a real municipal comparator, but it cannot be attributed to TSMC's project-specific reuse. Conversely, a named agreement and planned treatment facility define dependencies and milestones without proving delivered volume. Water-security claims require provider, source, treatment, quality, customer, period and competing-use denominators.
topic_chapters.historical_baseline: The bounded baseline joins an established reclaimed-water operating record with 2026 conservation, provider and capital-plan records. It documents how existing municipal service and proposed industrial infrastructure appear in the current shelf, not a complete hydrological or regional water history.
topic_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence supports existing municipal reclaimed-water scale, formal conservation and compliance layers, and named capital and customer agreements. The unresolved edge is accepted project infrastructure and measured customer-specific supply, reuse, quality and reliability over time.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify provider, right, allocation, conservation rule, quality standard and affected users.
Separate plan, budget, agreement, design, procurement and construction.
Record treatment and conveyance acceptance, customer connection, capacity and quality tests.
Measure delivered and reused volume, reliability, quality, cost and ecosystem or household effects.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Regional reclaimed-water scale proves a named industrial customer is using that volume.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The Chandler and TSMC records have different system and customer identities and cannot be merged.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A capital plan or infrastructure agreement resolves future water security.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The records preserve design, construction, acceptance, measured service and operating reliability as later gates.

decisive_evidence: Accepted treatment and conveyance assets tied to the named customer or service area.
Metered supply, reuse, discharge and quality records on a stable monthly or annual period.
Reliability, cost and competing-use evidence that retains provider and user identities.
claim_boundaries: Municipal system scale cannot be attributed to a project without a customer-specific record.
A plan or agreement does not establish completed water infrastructure.
Conserved or reused volume from different entities and periods is not automatically comparable.

foundation_chapters.title: Evidence and claim boundaries
foundation_chapters.deck: A trustworthy public record says precisely what changed, which source supports it, and which attractive conclusions remain outside the evidence.
executive_synthesis: FTFN treats a source as support for a bounded claim, not as authority for every interpretation adjacent to it. DARPA's Lift Challenge result supports named measured ratios and awards; it does not support certified service. Chandler's operating reclaimed-water record supports a municipal system scale; it does not support a TSMC-specific reuse volume. Toronto's council action supports a procedural gate; it does not support completed housing.

This discipline produces useful negative space. Each record identifies subject, geography, date, stage and limitation, then names what later artifact would justify a stronger claim. The result is not excessive caution: it is a mechanism for making progress legible without allowing announcements, aggregate context or adjacent evidence to impersonate delivery.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: The current editorial baseline is the repository's progression from source summaries and individual signal boundaries into named project files, conversion ledgers and dated evidence gates. This chapter codifies that accumulated method; it does not create a new factual layer over the cited records.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: Published records already carry source identity, evidence stage and editorial limits. The remaining challenge is consistent synthesis: every public chapter must preserve those limits when several records are joined and must expose disagreement or missing evidence rather than smoothing it away.

conversion_chain.reading: Confirm issuer, document, date, jurisdiction, version and accessible record.
Capture what the source directly states or measures without importing adjacent context.
Fix subject, geography, period, denominator, evidence stage and limitation.
Join only compatible records and retain every material boundary and contradiction.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A Tier 1 or official source is sufficient to make a broad claim.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Official records can be authoritative for a decision or measurement while remaining silent on implementation, causation or outcome.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Multiple citations make a synthesis claim stronger by accumulation.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Citations with mismatched identities, stages or periods cannot be counted into compatibility.

decisive_evidence: A direct source for the exact subject, event, geography and date in the claim.
An explicit denominator and method for every quantitative or comparative statement.
A later-stage record when language advances from authority to delivery, operation or outcome.
claim_boundaries: Official does not mean complete or universally applicable.
Corroboration does not repair an identity or denominator mismatch.
Editorial synthesis is not a new observation or causal finding.

foundation_chapters.title: The conversion ladder
foundation_chapters.deck: Research, rule, funding, construction, acceptance, operation and outcome are successive evidence states—not interchangeable synonyms for progress.
executive_synthesis: The conversion ladder is FTFN's central reading tool. NIST's post-quantum standards make migration actionable, GSA maps procurement paths, and federal plans create deadlines; production cutover and legacy retirement remain later evidence. In infrastructure, a TSMC planning envelope and topping-out milestone precede commissioning and qualified output. In mobility, authority for fared driverless service precedes exposure-based operating comparison.

A record can be materially important without occupying the final rung. The ladder recognizes exactly what was achieved and prevents stage inflation. It also turns uncertainty into an operational question by naming the artifact needed for the next transition.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository evolved from signal maturity labels into named project-conversion registries, event ledgers, gate calendars, acceptance controls and outcome-measurement contracts. The foundation synthesizes that existing architecture for readers while preserving the status of every upstream record.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus is dense at authority and infrastructure stages and has growing acceptance and operating records for selected assets. True longitudinal outcome series remain scarce by design. That distribution is itself evidence about what the public record can currently support.

conversion_chain.reading: Research result, strategy, target, selection, rule or standard defines a possibility or obligation.
Appropriation, contract, agreement, finance or accountable plan commits resources and owners.
Construction, installation, integration and commissioning create a candidate capability.
An authorized receiver accepts it; repeated service and stable measurement establish later claims.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Only operating outcomes count as meaningful progress.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Rules, finance and construction can remove real constraints; the error is to label them as later-stage achievements.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A standard maturity label applies uniformly across sectors.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The required acceptance authority and operating denominator differ across aircraft, cryptography, water systems and factories.

decisive_evidence: A named transition artifact accepted by the authority responsible for the next stage.
Identity continuity across project, asset, operator, geography and period.
A receipt that records the decision, evidence boundary and unresolved next gate.
claim_boundaries: The ladder orders evidence states; it does not score technologies or predict success.
Stages may iterate or reverse and should not be inferred from elapsed time.
A late-stage record for one asset does not advance every related project.

foundation_chapters.title: Dependencies and bottlenecks
foundation_chapters.deck: A frontier capability scales only as fast as the least-converted physical, institutional, human or ecological dependency required for use.
executive_synthesis: The Phoenix chip corridor requires land authority, power, water, wastewater, construction, tools, workforce and customer qualification. Northern Virginia compute growth meets transmission planning, large-load tariffs, air permits and local standards. Nevada mineral projects carry land, water, air, finance, processing and reclamation dependencies. These are not background conditions; they are parts of the capability.

A bottleneck is therefore a dated relationship, not a generic risk label. It should name the dependent project, responsible actor, required artifact, available capacity or condition and consequence of delay. Dependencies can also compound: a facility waiting for utility service may simultaneously face workforce and permit constraints, while solving one does not automatically solve the others.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: FTFN's local-system and project files moved the corpus beyond topic-only categorization by attaching frontier claims to utilities, permits, workforce, land and receiving institutions. This chapter synthesizes those published relationships without asserting a quantified causal weight for any dependency.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: The repository can identify many named dependencies and their authorities. It is less complete on capacity quantities, sequencing, shared-resource competition and the realized effect of one dependency on schedule or output. Those stronger claims require joined project records rather than narrative plausibility.

conversion_chain.reading: Name what is required, by which project, at which place and stage.
Identify provider, decision owner, available capacity, condition and competing demand.
Record prerequisite, lead time, interface and latest date compatible with the project schedule.
Link a documented constraint or release to a dated project-stage change without inferring causation.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Capital is the dominant constraint once a project is announced.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The named cases retain power, water, permits, workforce, qualification and public authority after financing is available.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Listing more dependencies provides a complete risk assessment.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: A useful dependency needs identity, owner, capacity, timing and evidence; generic lists can conceal rather than resolve uncertainty.

decisive_evidence: Provider- or authority-issued capacity and service decisions tied to the named project.
Interface schedules and acceptance records that show whether prerequisites arrived in sequence.
Dated project changes that can be joined to the same dependency without crossing identity boundaries.
claim_boundaries: A dependency map is not a causal estimate or probability of failure.
Regional capacity does not prove project-specific availability.
Removing one constraint does not establish completion of the conversion chain.

foundation_chapters.title: Authority, permission and public process
foundation_chapters.deck: A valid decision is defined by who may make it, what it permits, which conditions survive it and what review or appeal remains.
executive_synthesis: The repository contains many kinds of authority: Toronto council procedure, federal land decisions, FAA environmental and operating rules, CPUC service authority, utility rate approval and state permits. Each changes a different legal or administrative condition. None should be summarized simply as approval without naming the decision-maker and scope.

Permission is consequential because projects cannot lawfully advance without it, yet permission does not perform the permitted activity. Conditions, later permits, construction, acceptance and compliance remain downstream. Public process also includes standing, notice, review and appeal, which cannot be inferred from a final disposition alone.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: The current shelf traces selected projects through recommendations, final decisions, rules, licences and rate treatment. It provides a dated administrative baseline for those files, not a complete account of the law or every affected public's view.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: Evidence is strong on official decision identity and stated scope. It is uneven on condition discharge, appeals, compliance, participation outcomes and the join between authority and later operating evidence.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify legal basis, decision-maker, subject and geographic reach.
Preserve notice, hearing, recommendation, evidence, objections and appeal path.
Record effective date, conditions, expiry, dependencies and unresolved approvals.
Track condition discharge, inspection, enforcement and the actual permitted activity.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Final approval means a project's legal and public-process risk is over.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Named records retain enactment conditions, later permits, compliance, renewal and appeal as distinct states.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A decision by an authorized body demonstrates broad social consent.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Legal authority and public legitimacy are related but not identical; the source record cannot stand for every affected party.

decisive_evidence: The final executed decision with effective date, conditions and appeal status.
Dated evidence that each material condition and later authorization was satisfied.
Inspection, enforcement and operating records within the exact permitted scope.
claim_boundaries: Recommendation, approval, licence and operating authorization are different record types.
Authority does not prove construction, operation or outcome.
A lawful decision does not establish unanimous consent or absence of burden.

foundation_chapters.title: Finance, procurement and delivery
foundation_chapters.deck: A funding announcement becomes a usable asset through executed obligations, contracts, controlled construction, acceptance and whole-life operating capacity.
executive_synthesis: The shelf contains research awards, project selections, preliminary capital pipelines, federal loan close and a GAO finding that prototype agreements were not tracked consistently into production. Together they show why money needs an identity-preserving trail: authority, obligation, award, contract, expenditure, change order, acceptance and operation.

The central risk is denominator drift. Announced program totals, selected projects and executed finance answer different questions. Public delivery analysis must identify which amount is authorized, obligated, disbursed or spent, what scope it purchases, whether that scope changed and which receiving authority accepted the result.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: The current baseline joins several upstream capital records with later project-stage and oversight evidence. It illustrates recurring breaks between selection, contracting and production but does not estimate a universal delivery rate or attribute failure to any one instrument.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus can distinguish selections, executed finance and planned procurement from physical delivery. Complete contract-to-asset expenditure trails and comparable whole-life cost records remain limited for most projects.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify authority, ceiling, eligible scope, selected recipient and conditions.
Fix executed amount, instrument, milestones, deliverables, remedies and owner.
Track paid work, schedule, scope changes, inspections and unresolved defects.
Record receiving authority, accepted asset, operating cost, maintenance and liability.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A large award or loan amount is a useful proxy for delivered scale.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Selection, financial close, expenditure, physical scope and accepted output remain distinct in the named records.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Flexible prototype procurement naturally accelerates production transition.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: GAO's tracking-gap record shows that transition cannot be established without department-wide follow-through evidence.

decisive_evidence: Executed instrument, obligation and recipient records tied to the exact announced project.
Milestone, expenditure and change-control records that preserve original and revised scope.
Receiver acceptance and operating-cost evidence for the delivered asset or capability.
claim_boundaries: Program ceiling, selection, obligation and expenditure are not interchangeable amounts.
Financial close is not construction completion or production.
Accepted delivery does not by itself establish whole-life value.

foundation_chapters.title: Place and receiving systems
foundation_chapters.deck: Frontier systems arrive somewhere: in a utility territory, labor market, watershed, permitting regime and community that can enable, reshape or refuse conversion.
executive_synthesis: FTFN's place method is visible in Phoenix, Northern Virginia, Nevada, Toronto and the Space Coast. The same technical category encounters different utilities, land authorities, water systems, workforce institutions and public processes in each place. A national announcement therefore cannot reveal the local sequence required for delivery.

The receiving system is more than geography. It includes the institutions and people expected to absorb a capability: utilities must serve it, workers must operate it, public agencies must authorize and inspect it, customers must accept its output and communities experience its costs and benefits. Local evidence cannot be inferred from national totals, and a regional comparator cannot be attributed to a named project.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: The repository moved from topic pages to five canonical local systems and later editorial regional portraits. The cited signals supply project- and place-specific records within those systems. This chapter synthesizes that method rather than declaring any place fully represented.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: Place coverage is strongest where named projects have utility, permit, workforce or planning records. It remains geographically concentrated and often lacks joined household, community, ecosystem and service outcomes. Those gaps prevent simple claims of local benefit or burden.

conversion_chain.reading: Fix parcel, service territory, watershed, labor market, jurisdiction and affected public.
Identify utility, transport, housing, workforce, emergency and administrative capacity.
Track permits, agreements, construction, inspection, acceptance and community remedy.
Measure access, burden, affordability, resilience and benefit across named groups and periods.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A project located in a region creates a regional benefit proportional to announced investment.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: The local records retain qualification, access, housing, utility burden and distribution as separate unanswered questions.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: A nearby operating comparator can fill a missing project observation.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Chandler's water system and TSMC's wastewater agreement illustrate why adjacent geography does not establish project identity.

decisive_evidence: Project-specific service, permit and acceptance records within the exact local jurisdiction.
Local capacity and burden measures with provider, population and period denominators.
Affected-public and remedy records that preserve disagreement and distribution.
claim_boundaries: National or regional totals cannot be assigned to a local project without a join.
Geographic proximity is not evidence identity.
Local authorization does not establish broad legitimacy, delivery or distributed benefit.

foundation_chapters.title: Acceptance and repeated operation
foundation_chapters.deck: A capability becomes real for FTFN when an authorized receiver accepts it and evidence shows it continues to perform in its intended setting.
executive_synthesis: Acceptance provides the bridge between delivery and use. An F-15EX receipt belongs to a named receiving wing; Amtrak distinguishes passenger-use turnover from final completion; Kennedy's bridge is described as fully operational; Monaghan's certified record pairs project completion with current employment. Each is stronger than an announcement because a delivered object or facility has crossed a defined boundary.

Acceptance is still not the end. A receiver may accept an asset with open deficiencies, and one operating record may not establish availability, quality or reliability. Repeated operation requires a stable asset identity, intended service, period, denominator and record of failures, downtime or revision.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: The corpus first emphasized announcements and infrastructure stages, then added named project ledgers, acceptance dossiers and repeated-operation controls. The cited records show several accepted or operating edges while preserving the lack of a universal acceptance document across sectors.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: Selected cases now have receiver, completion or operation evidence. Recurring accepted output and named-asset reliability remain sparse, and many project files still stop at authorization or infrastructure. This chapter does not promote them by analogy.

conversion_chain.reading: Identify delivered scope, configuration, inspection and unresolved defect list.
Name authorized receiver, criteria, date, conditions and status of deficiencies.
Record intended use, operator, asset state, service and operating conditions.
Establish comparable cycles, output, availability, failure and maintenance over time.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: Substantial completion or passenger use is equivalent to final acceptance.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Amtrak publishes different passenger-use and final-completion cohorts, including only a partial overlap.

contested_interpretations.interpretation: One successful operating event proves dependable capacity.
contested_interpretations.counterevidence: Battery event and aircraft receipt records remain bounded until repeated availability and service evidence accumulates.

decisive_evidence: A receiver-signed acceptance or final-completion record for the exact asset and scope.
A stable operating series with asset, service, period and denominator fixed.
Failure, maintenance, remediation and return-to-service evidence joined to the same identity.
claim_boundaries: Completion candidate, substantial completion, passenger use and final acceptance may differ.
Accepted delivery does not prove availability or intended outcome.
One event or reporting period does not establish repeated operation.

foundation_chapters.title: Measurement, outcomes and denominators
foundation_chapters.deck: A number becomes decision evidence only when its subject, population, method, period, revision and relationship to the claimed outcome are explicit.
executive_synthesis: The repository contains instructive denominators: airline cancellation rates refer to reporting carriers and a year; Amtrak station and deployment totals refer to changing cohorts; battery nameplate refers to an asset's stated power capacity; federal AI inventories count reported use cases; Chandler reports municipal reclaimed-water scale. Each number answers a different question.

Outcome analysis fails when those identities disappear. Counts cannot be compared across revised populations without reconciliation, a capacity number does not measure use, and an administrative inventory does not measure benefit. FTFN therefore treats denominator, period, method and series break as parts of the claim rather than technical appendices.
foundation_chapters.historical_baseline: Earlier source records supplied isolated quantities; later phases added longitudinal panels, measurement dictionaries, observation admission and series-break controls. Most controlled outcome panels remain unpopulated because compatible repeated observations have not yet arrived. That restraint is part of the evidence state.
foundation_chapters.current_evidence_state: The corpus offers several reusable administrative and asset series, plus explicit examples of revisions and breaks. It does not yet support broad causal or outcome comparison across topics, and the chapter makes no attempt to manufacture one from heterogeneous measures.

conversion_chain.reading: Name concept, unit, numerator, denominator, inclusion rule and source method.
Fix subject, geography, period, version, capture date and uncertainty.
